svg.title: Premium Heathland — overhead SVG golf course presentation prototype
svg.desc: An orthographic SVG scene with a vibrant active fairway, genuine-looking surrounding holes, open sandy heath, purple heather, yellow gorse, scattered pines, continuous rounded green-end landforms, clear golf access and side lighting. Static illustrative geometry.

g.aria-label: Fine heath soil and dry rough texture
Sparse Scots pine woodland and small groups
